name: Horizontal Bullet-Hell Shooter (Godot Web)
description: A complete horizontal bullet-hell shooter with a corgi pilot, scrolling star graveyard, three combat segments, four distinct bosses, automatic fire, three weapon upgrades, laser and shield abilities, keyboard/touch controls, English/Chinese UI with saved language selection, browser-language detection, Orbitron/Smiley Sans display type with Exo 2 + Noto Sans SC UI fonts, bounded audio, local tuning and Web/PCK delivery.
